fossil_tool.name: Fossil Tool
fossil_tool.lore: A chipped blade older than the bones it freed. The Earth Offering in the Dune Court wants it.

worldroot_key.name: Worldroot Key
worldroot_key.lore: Opens the root-barred door to the Worldroot Fault.

onDone.text: Earth slumps away from a burrow mouth in the north wall.

waves.say: The pit shakes. Things dig toward you.

onDone.text: The shaking stops. A chipped Fossil Tool lies in the gravel.
The sandgate runs open like an hourglass. A fault yawns beyond.

onStep.text: Sand hisses behind the wall. The second lever.

mechanics.jam: The gate is packed solid. The north lever first.

onDone.text: Sand drains from a survey vault in the north-east wall.

onOpen.text: The tool fits the groove and the sand pours out of a gate in the south wall.

mechanics.hint: A block of carved sandstone with a groove for a blade.
mechanics.verb: sets the Fossil Tool in the groove and the gate runs open.

onOpen.text: The root-barred door to the Worldroot Fault opens.

mechanics.hint: A door barred by a thick root, a keyhole where the root meets the stone.
mechanics.verb: turns the Worldroot Key and the root-barred door opens.

encounters.say: Wheels and spoil heaps. The diggers never left.
Dunes drift in a windless room. Survey posts stand in the north; a grooved altar in the south.

bosses.name: The Worldroot Warden
bosses.intro: The Worldroot Warden climbs out of the fault. Break the three raw-gold wards on the pillars to crack its crust.
bosses.deathText: The Worldroot Warden sinks back into the fault, root by root.

shield.breakText: The wards crack! The Warden is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Worldroot Warden calls its servants.

effects.text: Roots tear free of the fault.

completion.intro: The Worldroot Fault. Open the sandgate and brave the fault steps.
completion.message: The ground settles. The fault closes shortly.
